newsitem.title: GERMANY: Krupp plans further steel price rises.
newsitem.headline: Krupp plans further steel price rises.

text.p: German steel group Krupp Hoesch Stahl AG said on Monday it would raise prices in January, and that further increases could be expected.

The Fried. Krupp AG Hoesch-Krupp unit said the 30 marks a tonne increase in flat steel products effective January 1, announced by chairman Hans Grasshoff at the International Iron & Steel Institute meeting in Helsinki in October, was a first step.
"This price increase, however, is still far from compensating for the revenue declines suffered in the past years," the company said in a statement. "Further price increases are planned in 1997.
